text:
Sam: Quick thread to capture feature asks from onboarding and renewal-check conversations this week. I'm trying to collect concrete signals (ask, pain, customer, frequency, severity) to hand to product. Fill the sheet or paste short notes here.

Leah: From Renewals sync with HelixCardio: they asked for a 'per-customer model pin' so they can lock to an older quantized variant during audits. Reason: their compliance team requires deterministic outputs during a 90-day validation window.

Diego: Found two small customers asking for clearer cost breakdowns per API route in billing exports. They want CSV rows per route+model to reconcile with finance.

Maya: Note from an onboarding call: one customer got confused by the embed freshness phrasing 'last indexed' vs 'last uploaded' and re-indexed multiple times. UX language tweak + tooltip could avoid churn.

Sam: Proposed capture fields: customer | ask-summary | exact ask (user language) | pain | times-heard | impact-score (1-5) | notes-link | tags.

CSBot: Reminder: add tag `renewal-risk` for anything called out during renewal discussions.

Leah: HelixCardio ask severity: 5 (regulatory blocking). Put them as renewal-risk.

Diego: I'll add the CSV-billing request to the shared sheet and link a sample billing extract.

Maya: Added onboard clip and suggested tooltip copy: 'Last indexed: time we last rebuilt search vectors. Last uploaded: time you uploaded files.'

Sam: Cool. I'll batch these into a one-pager and propose two implementation paths: (1) quick UX copy + billing CSV workaround (low effort) (2) scoped model-pin API + audit logs (mid effort, high impact). Targeting a product sync Fri.

Leah: If we build "model pin" we should include an audit log of inference calls with model_version metadata. HelixCardio will need evidence for the audit.

Diego: Agree on billing CSV rows. That should be a fast win.

Sam: Everyone add any other asks by EOD. Will ping product with the top 4 asks and proposed next steps. :rocket:
